plan.title: Save attachment from URL on eRFX draft

steps.note: Open an existing draft event without creating or publishing a new event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Confirm the selected existing event is a draft create screen.
Enter the valid URL supplied by the case.
Save the URL attachment to the draft.
Verify the Upload Attachments window closed after saving.
Verify the saved URL is visible in the draft attachments.
